title: まきばのなかよしたち (Makiba no Nakayoshi-tachi)
description: A family visits a farm in a green valley surrounded by forested hills. The children meet cows, pigs, and discover wheat fields and a stream full of freshwater clams. A lively, nature-rich story about farm animals, rural landscapes, and the joy of discovering where food comes from.
author: オリジナル
